name: So, this Vampire Walks into a Bar
source:
Join our broke and disfigured protagonist Jackie, as they desperately try to make ends meet by working in a creepy bar, despite having no experience at all! What kind of strange customers will come in? How will the drinks you make affect the outcome of the game?

[from [url=https://unluckyplanetgames.itch.io/so-this-vampire-walks-into-a-bar]itch.io[/url]]
